packageRules.description: package.json, package-lock.json and composer.json hold development tooling only and none reaches wordpress.org, so version-bump.yml ignores them: these merges publish nothing (the release-guard job of tests.yml fails a Renovate pull request that would). Tests runs PHPUnit on PHP 8.0/8.2/8.4, phpcs, PHPCompatibility, ESLint, Prettier, lint-staged, the admin CSS rebuild and the zip contents, so a broken update stays open. No required checks on main (the release job pushes straight to it), so Renovate itself waits for green checks: platformAutomerge is off.
No test runs deploy.yaml: a broken action would only show at the next release. GitHub Actions updates stay as pull requests to review.
